about: In Park Beyond, you are the creative force behind a series of amusement parks, a Visioneer, a combination of a creator, a manager, and a designer.
In your role as Visioneer, every aspect of creating, managing, and designing successful amusement parks will be under your control.
CREATE THE PARKS OF YOUR DREAMS
As creative lead of the park, you can let your imagination off the leash!
Build wild loops and hoops for a coaster like no other to attract thrill-seeking teens, research exciting flat rides to appeal to adults, or pop down cheery, adorable flat rides for families.
But, you can also take things to the next level with unbelievable modules that add unique pizzazz to your park.
summary: Dare to dream the impossible!  Defy every limit and impossify your world.
